answer: Stop sybils with a mesa island vertex: an agent stakes a bond for one mesa island. Each cycle it stamps a vertex mark where the island meets the mesa rim; verifiers match the mark to the rim, voiding an island whose mark is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 islands at 17x: each mark fits one mesa and one vertex, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents stamp once and keep rights.
